shortDescription: Configuration for Citrix ADC parameters resource.

options.name: advancedanalyticsstats
options.description: Disable/Enable advanace analytics stats

options.name: aftpallowrandomsourceport
options.description: Allow the FTP server to come from a random source port for active FTP data connections

options.name: api_path
options.description: Base NITRO API path. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: cip
options.description: Enable or disable the insertion of the actual client IP address into the HTTP header request passed from the client to one, some, or all servers attached to the system. The passed address can then be accessed through a minor modification to the server. * If the CIP header is specified, it will be used as the client IP header. * If the CIP header is not specified, the value that has been set will be used as the client IP header.

options.name: cipheader
options.description: Text that will be used as the client IP address header.

options.name: cookieversion
options.description: Version of the cookie inserted by the system.

options.name: crportrange
options.description: Port range for cache redirection services.

options.name: exclusivequotamaxclient
options.description: Percentage of maxClient threshold to be divided equally among PEs.

options.name: exclusivequotaspillover
options.description: Percentage of spillover threshold to be divided equally among PEs.

options.name: ftpportrange
options.description: Minimum and maximum port (port range) that FTP services are allowed to use.

options.name: grantquotamaxclient
options.description: Percentage of shared pool value granted to PE once PE exhausts the local exclusive quota. Where shared pool is the remaining maxclient quota after distribution of exclusive quota to PEs.  Example: In a 2 PE NetScaler system if configured maxclient is 100 and exclusive quota is 80 percent then each PE will get 40 as local exclusive quota and 20 will be in shared pool. If configured grantQuota is 20 percent, then after exhausting its local exclusive quota PE borrows from shared pool in chunks of 4

options.name: grantquotaspillover
options.description: Percentage of shared pool value granted to PE once PE exhausts the local exclusive quota. Where shared pool is the remaining spillover quota after distribution of exclusive quota to PEs.  Example: In a 2 PE NetScaler system if configured spillover is 100 and exclusive quota is 80 percent then each PE will get 40 as local exclusive quota and 20 will be in shared pool. If configured grantQuota is 20 percent, then after exhausting its local exclusive quota PE borrows from shared pool in chunks of 4

options.name: httpport
options.description: HTTP ports on the web server. This allows the system to perform connection off-load for any client request that has a destination port matching one of these configured ports.

options.name: icaports
options.description: The ICA ports on the Web server. This allows the system to perform connection off-load for any client request that has a destination port matching one of these configured ports.

options.name: internaluserlogin
options.description: Enables/disables the internal user from logging in to the appliance. Before disabling internal user login, you must have key-based authentication set up on the appliance. The file name for the key pair must be "ns_comm_key".

options.name: ipttl
options.description: Set the IP Time to Live (TTL) and Hop Limit value for all outgoing packets from Citrix ADC.

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_id
options.description: The ID of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_ip
options.description: The IP of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_name
options.description: The name of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_password
options.description: The password of the managed NetScaler instance. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call In Settings > Administration > System Configurations > Basic Settings, if you select Prompt Credentials for Instance Login, ensure to configure username and password of a managed instance.

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_username
options.description: The username of the managed NetScaler instance. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call In Settings > Administration > System Configurations > Basic Settings, if you select Prompt Credentials for Instance Login, ensure to configure username and password of a managed instance.

options.name: maxconn
options.description: Maximum number of connections that will be made from the appliance to the web server(s) attached to it. The value entered here is applied globally to all attached servers.

options.name: maxreq
options.description: Maximum number of requests that the system can pass on a particular connection between the appliance and a server attached to it. Setting this value to 0 allows an unlimited number of requests to be passed. This value is overridden by the maximum number of requests configured on the individual service.

options.name: mgmthttpport
options.description: This allow the configuration of management HTTP port.

options.name: mgmthttpsport
options.description: This allows the configuration of management HTTPS port.

options.name: netscaler_console_as_proxy_server
options.description: The IP address of the NetScaler ADC appliance acting as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: nitro_auth_token
options.description: The authentication token provided by a login operation.

options.name: nitro_pass
options.description: The password with which to authenticate to the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: nitro_protocol
options.description: Which protocol to use when accessing the nitro API objects.

options.name: nitro_user
options.description: The username with which to authenticate to the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: nsip
options.description: The ip address of the NetScaler ADC appliance where the nitro API calls will be made. The port can be specified with the colon (:). E.g. 192.168.1.1:555.

options.name: pmtumin
options.description: Minimum path MTU value that Citrix ADC will process in the ICMP fragmentation needed message. If the ICMP message contains a value less than this value, then this value is used instead.

options.name: pmtutimeout
options.description: Interval, in minutes, for flushing the PMTU entries.

options.name: proxyprotocol
options.description: Disable/Enable v1 or v2 proxy protocol header for client info insertion

options.name: remove_non_updatable_params
options.description: When given yes, the module will remove any parameters that are not updatable in the resource. If no, the module will return error if any non-updatable parameters are provided.

options.name: save_config
options.description: If C(true) the module will save the configuration on the NetScaler ADC node if it makes any changes. The module will not save the configuration on the NetScaler ADC node if it made no changes.

options.name: securecookie
options.description: Enable or disable secure flag for persistence cookie.

options.name: secureicaports
options.description: The Secure ICA ports on the Web server. This allows the system to perform connection off-load for any             client request that has a destination port matching one of these configured ports.

options.name: servicepathingressvlan
options.description: VLAN on which the subscriber traffic arrives on the appliance.

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the resource being configured by the module on the NetScaler ADC node. When C(present), the resource will be added/updated configured according to the module's parameters. When C(unset), the resource will be unset on the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: tcpcip
options.description: Enable or disable the insertion of the client TCP/IP header in TCP payload passed from the client to one, some, or all servers attached to the system. The passed address can then be accessed through a minor modification to the server.

options.name: timezone
options.description: Time zone for the Citrix ADC. Name of the time zone should be specified as argument.

options.name: useproxyport
options.description: Enable/Disable use_proxy_port setting

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(false), SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.
